newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL shares end weaker on lack of institution buying.
newsitem.headline: KL shares end weaker on lack of institution buying.

text.p: Malaysian shares ended weaker on Monday as a lack of institutional support saw the morning's sharp gains being erased, dealers and analysts said.
At the close the benchmark Composite index of 100 large-capitalised stocks slipped 2.99 points to 1,094.97 while the small-capitalised Second Board index lost 0.83 of a point to 557.28.
"London is shut today for a bank holiday, so there was no support in the afternoon," said an analyst at a large foreign brokerage house in Kuala Lumpur.
